pathwayChoice.name: Architecture Pathway
pathwayChoice.reason: This program aligns with your goal of becoming an architect.

summary: You'll start with foundational courses in your first semester, focusing on communication and design. This pathway sets you up for a successful transfer to FIU.
warnings: A minimum GPA of 3.0 is required for transfer to FIU.
A design portfolio must be submitted for admission to the FIU Accelerated Master of Architecture program.
Ensure to complete all prerequisites for advanced courses to avoid delays in the program.
Be mindful of limits on attempts for courses, as repeated attempts may affect your GPA and transfer eligibility.
nextSteps: Meet with an Advisor to confirm your term plan.
Prepare for your design portfolio for FIU transfer.
Register for your first semester courses as soon as possible.
advisorQuestions: Can you confirm the specific courses required for the Architecture Pathway?
What resources are available for building a design portfolio?
Are there any additional scholarships or financial aid opportunities?
Can you provide guidance on maintaining a GPA of 3.0 or higher?
